about_the_game:
Welcome to the Mooncorona Demo!

As our studio's debut indie title, this demo offers a curated slice of the full experience (approx. 30hrs total playtime), featuring:

  • Early-game story chapters

  • Core gameplay systems

  • Ongoing optimizations based on your feedback

We’re thrilled to finally share our fantasyland with you! Stay tuned for Early Access and full release updates. Hope you enjoy the journey~

Discord（Mooncorona Official）：

Thanks for testing! Your insights will help us shape a better game.

◆ What Kind of Game Is This?

RPG? Story? Cards? Strategy? Adventure?

The answer: All of the above—

◆ Diverse Landscapes

  • Castles·Wilderness·Villages·Cities·Churches·Dungeons

  • Each area holds unique historical imprints

  • Encounter characters·Rewrite stories·Gain legacy powers

◆ Vast Card Collection

  • Over 100 unique cards with distinct effects

  • Class-specific cards: Tailor attacks to your profession

  • Customizable public cards: Fill class weaknesses

  • Melee mages, tanky hunters, agile berserkers... endless combos await

◆ Unique Professions

  • Start with 5 base classes, grow stronger in Reinhart

  • Barbarian, Hero, Elemental Master, Demolitionist... 40+ professions

  • No "correct" build—only the perfect synergy

◆ Dynamic Combat

  • Monster Part Break System: Target weaknesses for advantage

  • Side-scrolling Movement: Dodge and terrain-based kills

  • Faction Dynamics: Turn the tide using rivalries

◆ Your Story, Your Legacy

Clashing thrones and holy orders, entangled divinity and curses

Magic vs. technology, chaos and rebirth cycles

[p>Ordinary souls struggling against fate's torrent]

Every choice rewrites history

But remember: Not every tale can be saved

short_description: A deck-building RPG where you awaken in an ancient temple as an adventurer. Explore Reinhart Duchy's perilous lands, collect cards, forge unique combos, and make pivotal choices to uncover lost truths and redemption. Every decision shapes your path through chaos and danger.
supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
